textSequence: I'm applying for the Senior Backend Engineer role on your payments platform team. I've spent four years building high-volume services in Go and Python, most recently the shipment events service at Tarnhollow Logistics, which handles about 40 million events a day.

Your posting mentions write latency and on-call load, and both have been my work this past year. I moved our service from a single database to partitioned PostgreSQL tables, which cut p95 write latency from 220 ms to 35 ms. I also rewrote our alerts and runbook, and pages per week dropped from 14 to 4.

I also enjoy the parts of the job around the code, like design reviews, mentoring and writing things down so the next person doesn't have to ask. I currently mentor two junior engineers and review most of the team's pull requests.
Thank you for your time. I'd be glad to talk through the database migration or anything else on my resume.
